title: MedBridge Exercise Reps Completed Leaderboard
dataSources: MedBridge exercises (`medbridge:exercise`), PT clinic sessions (`pt:session`), Hinge Health sessions (`hingehealth:session`), rehab range-of-motion logs (`rehab:rom`), and pain diary entries (`pain:diary`).
app: MedBridge exercise completions, clinic PT session exports, Hinge Health digital sessions, ROM measurement logs, and pain diary entries forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=medbridge:exercise reps_completed=*
| stats sum(reps_completed) as total_value, avg(reps_completed) as avg_value by exercise_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks exercise values by total and average reps completed across MedBridge exercise events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `reps_completed` values for each MedBridge exercise event and review total and average reps completed by exercise.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total reps completed.
grandmaExplanation: It compares which exercise shows the biggest reps completed numbers in your MedBridge exercise data.
